turns.text: Hey Lloyd, did you order the new thermal paste yet? The old tube is basically empty.
Yes, I placed the order for the Arctic MX-6 yesterday. It should arrive by Friday.
Perfect. Thanks. Also, I'm still tweaking the config for the new GPU cluster. It's annoying how specific the driver requirements are.
I can check the compatibility matrix if you send me the specific node models.
No need, I figured it out. I just need to remember that Octo Server is a named alternative for retail 5090 nodes when I'm talking to the vendor, so I don't sound like I'm just buying random parts.
Noted. I'll keep that terminology in mind for your procurement notes.
Great. By the way, is it going to rain this weekend? I was planning to wash the car.
The forecast shows a high chance of showers on Saturday, but Sunday looks clear.
